title: Ancient Tailed Demon — Rites of the Sealed
revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree

classification.selector: jutsu classification: the qualifying element(s), whatever the jutsu's source
classification.applies_to: matching supported tags on all Ancient Tailed Demon-classified jutsu
not_selectors: equipment / required bloodline item (castability gate only)
classification.off_kit_coverage: unverified (no non-bloodline jutsu catalog with effect rows in the repository)

emphasis.primary: The host (Demon's Marrow, in every build): a field rampage or a fortress, both on Demonic Vitae
emphasis.secondary: The marked prey (Demon's Grasp): Afterburn and exposure together on one Demonic Embrace target
emphasis.tertiary: Ancient Demon Roar Damage as Primordial Rampage's controlled +2 payoff (45 → 47, High tier kept)
emphasis.rationale: Three casts, one supported row per tag. Demonic Embrace's Afterburn (35%) and Increase Damage Taken (35%) share one target and one 2-round window and both multiply each hit that target takes from anyone, so they are one lever and form one marked-prey route. Demonic Vitae carries the two self buffs (Increase Damage Given 35% for 3 rounds, Decrease Damage Taken 25% for 2), which split into a field rampage and a fortress. Ancient Demon Roar's single 45 EP row stays in the High tier: its +2 rides the rampage, the one route whose lever also reaches every enemy in the circle.

nodes.name: Demon's Grasp
nodes.flavor: A claw closes around the prey, and what it touches begins to smoulder.
nodes.coverage_note: Demonic Embrace only: Afterburn 35 → 37% and exposure 35 → 37% on one target for 2 rounds (40 AP, range 4, cooldown 7).

nodes.name: Festering Brand
nodes.flavor: Flesh the demon marks does not stop burning when the claw lets go.
nodes.coverage_note: Demonic Embrace Afterburn 40% with Demon's Grasp: for 2 rounds the marked target takes 40% extra from each instant non-pierce hit, allies' included.

nodes.name: Consuming Malice
nodes.flavor: Hatred older than the villages, poured into a single victim.
nodes.coverage_note: Marked prey: on the full route Demonic Embrace Afterburn 35 → 45% (below the 60% per-hit cap) and exposure 35 → 40%, so each instant non-pierce hit on the target is worth ≈ ×1.40 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.03 (×1.82 unmodified), allies' included, for 2 rounds.

nodes.name: Demon's Marrow
nodes.flavor: The blood runs black and hot, and the host grows harder to kill.
nodes.coverage_note: Demonic Vitae only (self, 40 AP, cooldown 7): Increase Damage Given 35 → 37% for 3 rounds, Decrease Damage Taken 25 → 27% for 2; neither touches pierce hits. In every legal build.

nodes.name: Scarred Hide
nodes.flavor: A thousand years of wounds, and every one of them closed over.
nodes.coverage_note: Demonic Vitae Decrease Damage Taken 30% with Demon's Marrow, for 2 rounds (non-pierce hits of any stat type).

nodes.name: Unyielding Husk
nodes.flavor: What the host cannot dodge, the demon simply refuses to feel.
nodes.coverage_note: Fortress: Decrease Damage Taken route total +10%, Demonic Vitae 25 → 35% for 2 rounds (damage taken ×0.75 → ×0.65). Pierce still passes through.

nodes.name: Boiling Ichor
nodes.flavor: Let a little more of it loose, and every strike carries the heat.
nodes.coverage_note: Demonic Vitae Increase Damage Given 40% with Demon's Marrow, for 3 rounds, on all your non-pierce damage (jutsu, weapons, basics).

nodes.name: Primordial Rampage
nodes.flavor: The seal holds, barely. Everything within reach learns what that costs.
nodes.coverage_note: Field rampage: Demonic Vitae Increase Damage Given 35 → 43% for 3 rounds on every non-pierce hit you land (route +8%); Ancient Demon Roar 45 → 47 EP on every enemy in its circle (High tier kept).

examples.name: Consuming Malice
examples.rationale: Embrace one enemy and cast Vitae in the same round (80 AP), then fight it for 2 rounds: Afterburn 45% and exposure 40% make each instant non-pierce hit it takes worth ≈ ×1.40 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.03 from anyone, and the caster's own hits carry Vitae 37% on top (≈ ×2.78). Every other enemy sees only Vitae 37%; Roar stays at 45 EP. Demon's Marrow is the fixed fourth purchase.

examples.name: Unyielding Husk
examples.rationale: Demonic Vitae's Decrease Damage Taken reaches 35% for 2 rounds (the +10% route) with Increase Damage Given 37%. Demon's Grasp is the fourth purchase (Embrace 37% / 37%); Boiling Ichor instead gives Vitae Increase Damage Given 40%. Roar stays at 45 EP.

examples.name: Primordial Rampage
examples.rationale: Demonic Vitae's Increase Damage Given reaches 43% for the 3 rounds after each cast on every non-pierce hit the caster lands, and Ancient Demon Roar lands at 47 EP on every enemy in its circle (≈ 47 × 1.43 against 45 × 1.37 on the Malice build). Demon's Grasp adds Embrace 37% / 37% so the window still has a marked target; Scarred Hide (Vitae Decrease Damage Taken 30%) is the all-Vitae alternative.

narrow_kit_exception: Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has five supported rows, one per tag, on three casts. Afterburn and Increase Damage Taken share Demonic Embrace's one target and 2-round window and both multiply each hit that target takes, so they form one marked-prey route, not two: the former Flayed Quarry → Howl of Annihilation route and Consuming Malice were the same choice with names hidden. Ancient Demon Roar's single 45 EP Damage row cannot carry a route of its own without reaching the 50 Nuke tier, so its +2 rides Primordial Rampage. A fourth Advanced Art would repeat one of the three. Demon's Marrow is a universal node (in all 8 legal 4-BP builds) because Demon's Grasp roots a single 3-node chain, so every build carries Vitae 37% / 27% and the Consuming Malice build's fourth purchase is fixed.
design_notes: Structure (rewired to 2/3/3): Demon's Grasp raises both Demonic Embrace debuffs and roots one marked-prey chain (Festering Brand → Consuming Malice); Demon's Marrow raises both Demonic Vitae buffs and forks into fortress (Scarred Hide → Unyielding Husk) or field rampage (Boiling Ichor → Primordial Rampage). Flayed Quarry and Howl of Annihilation are removed (narrow-kit exception).

Damage: Draft 4's Damage line (+2 on a Hidden Art, +3 on its capstone) lifted Ancient Demon Roar 45 → 50, semi-nuke to nuke. Now the only flat Damage is Primordial Rampage's +2 (45 → 47, High tier kept), set up by Boiling Ichor's percentage.

Marked prey: Afterburn adds to each instant hit and Increase Damage Taken multiplies each hit (residual ticks included), so on Embrace's target they compound as one lever: route Afterburn 45% / exposure 40% ≈ ×2.03 per hit against ×1.82 unmodified. Afterburn is not damage over time; sources add and cap at 60% of a hit.

Pricing by reach: Vitae's Increase Damage Given multiplies every hit the caster lands on every target for 3 rounds, so its route is +8% (43%), not +10%. Strongest fourths against the marked target: Malice + Marrow ≈ 1.37 × 1.40 × 1.45 ≈ ×2.78 on the caster's hits and ×2.03 on allies'; Rampage + Grasp ≈ 1.43 × 1.37 × 1.37 ≈ ×2.68 and ×1.88, with Roar on that target about even (47 × 2.68 ≈ 126 against 45 × 2.78 ≈ 125, if Roar damage scales with EP). Rampage wins every other enemy (Roar ≈ 67 against 62) and Vitae's third round.

No cross-riders: each Vitae capstone carries only its own route's tags. Capstone plus sibling Hidden Art: 06,07,08,09 gives Increase Damage Given 40% / Decrease Damage Taken 35%; 06,07,09,10 gives 43% / 30% with Roar 47.
Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2, Increase Damage Given +8%, Increase Damage Taken +5%, Decrease Damage Taken +10%, Afterburn +10%.

Delivery: all three jutsu have cooldown 7 and no row acts in its own cast round (§3b). Embrace (one target, 40 AP) and Vitae (self, 40 AP) go a round before Roar (60 AP AoE circle) to touch it; Vitae's Increase Damage Given (3 rounds) raises Roar on every enemy in the circle, Embrace's debuffs only on the marked one.
risks: Classification: no kit row carries an element, so 'Ancient Tailed Demon' is the placeholder name of a new jutsu classification (requires classification extension), not a bloodline-id selector; all three kit jutsu qualify only through it (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Targeting None instead would reach every non-elemental row. Off-kit coverage is unverified.

Embrace leverage: its exposure (up to 40%) and Afterburn (up to 45%) apply to every non-pierce hit the marked target takes from the caster and allies for 2 rounds, so team play is worth more than the solo numbers. Afterburn sources add and cap at 60% of each hit, so a second Afterburn source saturates it.
Solo balance between Consuming Malice and Primordial Rampage is arithmetic only (per-hit multipliers, Roar damage assumed proportional to EP); no combat simulation.
Pierce: the four percentage tags do not touch pierce hits, so the tree is blind to pierce damage except through Roar's raw EP.

Ally hazard: Ancient Demon Roar's unsupported Wound row (35%, friendly fire none) lands on allies inside the circle; the caster is never a target (§4b). Embrace aimed at an ally (OTHER_USER permits it) would land both raised debuffs on that ally.
Skill-tree effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. The bloodline's 5% self Increase Damage Taken passive and AP economy were not modelled.

audit.revision: Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Ancient Tailed Demon classification / forked tree
limits: Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).

Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Ancient Tailed Demon-classified jutsu (requires classification extension). Off-kit jutsu of the element are in scope by rule; their count is unverified. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.
Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.
Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.
Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.

Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.
Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.
No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.
Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit.

foundation_sentences.01: How do I make the one enemy I have marked take more from every hit, mine and my allies'?
foundation_sentences.06: How do I strengthen the host: hit everything harder or refuse to fall?

route_identities.05: marked prey: one target takes more from every instant hit, allies' included
route_identities.10: field rampage: every own hit on any target harder, Roar's whole circle heaviest

design_review.director_review: Structural: the tree drops from four Advanced Arts to three (narrow-kit exception) because Afterburn and Increase Damage Taken on Demonic Embrace are one marked-prey lever; Flayed Quarry and Howl of Annihilation are removed and Demon's Marrow becomes universal.
concerns: Demon's Marrow is in every legal build, so the Consuming Malice build's fourth purchase is fixed and every build carries Vitae 37% / 27%.

Consuming Malice and Primordial Rampage are close in 1v1 by arithmetic (Malice ≈ +3.6% on the caster's non-Roar hits in Embrace's window, Rampage ≈ +4.4% in Vitae's third round, Roar on the marked target about even); not simulated.
Classification extension ('Ancient Tailed Demon' jutsu classification) remains a director/engine decision.
